title: IRONWEED header protection for frame counter (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A: QUIC-style header protection (RFC 9001 §5.4 pattern): mask the explicit frame counter (and any per-sender header field) with a value derived from a sample of the ciphertext and a header-protection key derived from the traffic key; receivers unmask before decryption; no added bytes.
